## Change and mathematical scope

Moving the left boundary before helper 466's A[1991] promotion does not remove the B508 frame requirement. In the retained PR1062 interval A[1991:2075], nine COPY/scatter/ERASE observations, and B[0:195], original source lines alone force all eleven B508 wires to contain F508. Their sharp contribution before this right cut is **8H2 + 3H3**, where Hr = r^(1-a), 0 < a < 1; rank mass 25. The baseline attains it with eleven single climbs.

The source-only rank-four conclusion also holds at all **1,992 left cuts A[k], 0 <= k <= 1991**, verified by 21,912 exact wire/cut checks. The displayed sharp invoice is specific to k=1991. Source 19's inverse source support is [19,35,66,89,97]; four original root lines already span F508, without relying on helper 466's old rank-four entry frame.

This is a scoped proof plus a finite certificate, not a complete interval optimum or supplier improvement. The model keeps the original endpoint, independent arbitrary dirt, monotone common-operand frames and no target/COPY feedback into the reversible source/helper subsystem. It permits arbitrary finite dirty workspace and reversible nonlinear gates. Source-only witnesses instantiate the credited semantic inverse-frame lemma; the general lemma is not claimed anew.

The package records the complete baseline profile and the nine COPY charges. Other interval wires, larger exit frames and changed continuation costs remain possible sources of savings. No new kappa, selected-result change, native multistage admission, hosting/precision result, all-size compiler/transfer proof or Lean formalization is claimed.

Artifact: `research/r439-donor466-enlarged-seam/`. Contribution commit: `0616027e3d31f5d50d329c6b78c4f7927cd0b2e3`; main was rechecked unchanged at 07:15 UTC before submission.

## Validation

CPython **3.12.3**, standard library only. Actual commands from the repository root:

```sh
timeout 180s python3 -B research/r439-bsection-stars-seed01/verify.py
timeout 120s python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-donor466-enlarged-seam --check-only
timeout 360s python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-donor466-enlarged-seam
git diff --cached --check
```

The predecessor's prescribed first control passed (`PASS_R439_BSECTION_STARS`, eight controls). The new package's metadata/source pins and registered replay passed. Registered commands run both engines and all ten tests with `-I -O -B`; all checks survive disabled assertions.

```text
PASS_R439_ENLARGED_SEAM cuts=1992 wire_cut_checks=21912 minimum=8H2+3H3 mass=25 no_new_kappa
PASS_R439_ENLARGED_SEAM_ORACLE direct_cut_replays=1992 rational_rank_checks=21912 full_matrix=661 COPY=9 minimum=8H2+3H3 no_new_kappa
Ran 10 tests ... OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r439-donor466-enlarged-seam outcome=completed
```

The separate checker replays every suffix from scratch, inverts the full forward matrix with set-valued Gauss-Jordan, implements literal COPY/ERASE, and checks rational independence by fraction-free integer elimination. The primary uses right-product cut updates, reverse-gate inversion and Fraction elimination. Neither imports a predecessor checker.

Failure controls include a wrong inverse support that still has rank four, dependent witnesses, the underpriced old B508 invoice, incomplete atlas coverage, an omitted scatter ADD that leaves all eleven witness records unchanged, changed source/feedback premises, and corrupted compressed input bytes. A 65,536-state fixture checks nonlinear source-preserving preparation and dirty auxiliary output. Forward-only support demonstrably misses source 19's obstruction.

Unrun obligations: complete interval optimality, a replacement circuit, changed right boundaries, native multistage replay, a full selected cold replay, physical hosting/precision admission, all-size compiler/analytic transfer and proof-assistant formalization. No hosted-CI pass or independent human review is asserted.

The registered replay (primary checker and separate oracle) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about five seconds and left the worktree unchanged. The invoice arithmetic checks by hand: with `H_r = r^(1-a)`, `8H2 + 3H3` has rank mass `8*2 + 3*3 = 25`.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json give two bounded follow-ups: price one other wire in this exact interval while retaining all observations, or move the right cut to a named source-changing boundary and recompute the inverse support. Both require a favorable complete invoice before synthesis. Merely moving the left cut cannot remove the checked F508 requirement. The known helper467-to-source27 substitution should not be repeated.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

Revision 4's explicit handoffs were useful: #1795 identified an exact interface change that avoided rediscovering B508. The main friction was separating a component floor from a complete moment bound. A short endpoint-contract field in future handoffs—especially whether targets or COPY outputs may return into the source/helper subsystem—would prevent accidental use of a common-frame invariant across a special COPY interface.
